objectives.description: Copy current settings.json/CLAUDE.md to scratchpad as pre-redeploy baseline
Clause 3: claude-stop-notify.sh count 1, one Stop *-block, no duplicated triples
Regression guard: permissions/mcpServers unchanged vs baseline

notes: Pre-redeploy live settings.json (a leftover from Phase 2's redeploy, which ran before the merge.lua fix existed) had 4 Stop matcher blocks with claude-stop-notify.sh appearing 3 times, empirically confirming the pre-fix defect was still reproducible at the start of this phase. After the fixed redeploy: CLAUDE.md sentinel=1, SECTION marker=0, all 5 loaded extension fragments (core, email, memory, nix, nvim) appear exactly once, 897 lines both runs and byte-identical (cmp). settings.json: claude-stop-notify.sh count=1, Stop array has exactly 1 '*' matcher block, zero duplicated (event,matcher,command) triples across the whole file. permissions/mcpServers are semantically identical to the pre-redeploy baseline (jq -S sorted-key diff empty; only object key insertion order changed, from JSON re-encoding, not content). verify-deploy.sh passed all 12 checks including the task-reference lint gate.
